channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Perhilitan seizes 180 white-rumped shama birds bound for Batam
item.description: KLUANG: The Johor Wildlife and National Parks Department (Perhilitan) recently foiled an attempt by a man to smuggle 180 white-rumped shama birds, worth about RM800,000, to Batam, Indonesia.

item.title: ART tram system too costly for Putrajaya, PPP model being weighed
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Perbadanan Putrajaya is open to exploring a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model to realise the Automated Rapid Transit (ART) system, but will not commit to the project without a thorough fiscal review.

item.title: Applications open for RM117mil MSME programmes under 13MP
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) can now submit applications to participate in 2026 programmes under the 13th Malaysia Plan (13MP) implemented by SME Corp Malaysia.

item.title: A call that cost a woman RM1.3 million in phone scam
item.description: KUANTAN: A 55-year-old assistant manager who answered a call from an unknown number last year never imagined it would cost her RM1.3 million in a phone scam.

item.title: Students at Pontian school undergo X-ray screenings after TB case detected
item.description: PONTIAN: The Pontian district health office has ordered X-ray screenings for students identified as close contacts following the detection of a tuberculosis (TB) case at a primary school here.

item.title: Man sought after viral road rage, cone-throwing incident at LDP toll plaza
item.description: SUBANG JAYA: Police are tracking down the driver of a red Perodua Axia who was filmed throwing a traffic cone and shouting insults during a road rage incident at the Damansara-Puchong Expressway (LDP) toll plaza.

item.title: Paralympic chief targets FAM top job to drive football reform
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Paralympic Council of Malaysia (PCM) president Megat D Shahriman Zaharudin has declared his intention to contest the FA of Malaysia (FAM) presidency following the collective resignation of the association’s executive committee.

item.title: Four arrested with over RM3mil fireworks meant for festive celebrations
item.description: KOTA BARU: The General Operations Force (GOF) seized 1,031 boxes of firecrackers and fireworks worth RM3.09 million and arrested four men in an operation here last week.

item.title: Minority shareholders take Jentayu Sustainables to court over governance concerns
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Shareholders holding slightly more than 10 per cent stake in Jentayu Sustainables Bhd has initiated legal proceedings in the High Court to protect governance at the company.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Aliff Syukri: Despite investing RM1 million, my songs only receive brickbats
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Entrepreneur and social media personality Datuk Seri Aliff Syukri Kamarzaman is unhappy that his efforts and money poured into making music have not been appreciated but ridiculed.
